verifiedSample50.sourceDescription: "Pongwiffy has it all...a hovel of her own, a sometime-friend named Sharkadder, and an odor only a witch could love.  Everything is almost perfect--until a gaggle of goblins move in next door..."

Yeye stikhi i rasskazy pol'zuyutsya ogromnoy populyarnost'yu u chitateley. V knigu "Khorosho byt' optimistom!" voshli rasskazy o shkol'nikakh, ob ikh veseloy, bezzabotnoy, no poroy takoy neprostoy zhizni."--T.p. verso.
